people.name: Kedar
people.line: A son of Ishmael and a nomadic tribe

translations.web: For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,
translations.bsb: For this is what the Lord says to me: “Within one year, as a hired worker would count it, all the glory of Kedar will be gone.
translations.kjv: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:
translations.asv: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of a hireling, all the glory of Kedar shall fail;
